title: Homogeneous quadratic proof tester
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number and let $L$ be a finite list of equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements, each specified by a coefficient matrix and a right-hand side. The associated Boolean tester uses four query positions and addresses from the disjoint union of the $n$ input positions and $2^n+2^{n^2}$ proof positions; it is the uniform mixture of the quadratic-pair proof tester, the quadratic-system proof tester for $L$, and the quadratic input-consistency tester.
hypotheses_covered: A list $L$ of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements
caveat: The auxiliary testers and the precise uniform-mixture construction are not defined in the supplied statement.
